risk_note: RV2 by path (union, platform). TAOBAO_SEARCH_SOURCE gains official_first (D10-582); unset stays official and dataoke is unchanged. On the first page only, official failures (upstream_unavailable, rate_limited, upstream_rejected, timeout, conversion failure) and empty results fall back to dataoke; invalid_dto, adapter_unimplemented and caller cancellation do not. One request uses one source, results are never merged, and the cursor prefix keeps later pages on the source of page 1. quoted_at is taken from the source actually used (BR-PRICE-11). Because the fallback sits inside the adapter the breaker does not see official failures, so official gets half the budget and failures start a 60-second in-process cooldown; empty results do not. The conversion cache is split per source. Counter couli_taobao_search_total on the api entry only, warning alert CouliTaobaoSearchFallbackHigh in couli.yaml. Conversion untouched. Default behaviour unchanged until the switch is set.
